sanskrit_verse:
पर्णोदुम्बरराजीवबिल्वपत्रकुशोदकैः ।
प्रत्येकं प्रत्यहं पीतैः पर्णकृच्छ्र उदाहृतः ॥
transliteration: parṇodumbararājīvabilvapatrakuśodakaiḥ | pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pītaiḥ parṇakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Parṇakṛcchra penance is executed through the daily ingestion of specific botanical elements: one leaf each of Palāśa (Butea monosperma), Udumbara (Ficus racemosa), Rājīva (lotus), Bilva (Bael), and Kuśa grass, along with water, consumed individually and consistently.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the precise adherence to dharma-prescribed ritual acts
Causation flows from intentional alignment with elemental purification
Capacity-based responsibility requires bodily and mental readiness for observance
Restoration logic operates through sequential reintegration of natural substances
Consciousness alignment emerges via disciplined repetition of divinely ordained acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs daily ingestion of specified botanicals AND maintains continuity THEN Parṇakṛcchra observance is valid
IF botanical source deviates from Palāśa OR Udumbara OR Rājīva OR Bilva OR Kuśa THEN observance is nullified
IF agent discontinues ingestion for more than one tithi THEN restart protocol initiates
IF ingestion occurs without intention THEN act does not count toward kṛcchra completion
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold for dharmic compliance where intent and material precision determine validity. Legal capacity is assessed based on sustained adherence rather than isolated performance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that purification arises only when correct substances are ingested with awareness. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures gradual refinement of consciousness. Responsibility is proportional to access and knowledge. There is no punitive value; only restoration through disciplined action.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Daily tracking of ingestion until full cycle achieved
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Agent must reaffirm commitment upon break
Capacity Restoration: Dietary and spiritual preparation before resuming
Integrity Reintegration: Guided reflection after completion to align consciousness
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law flows directly from SPH's Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored through conscious observance. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
